name: Band Single-Arm Overhead Curl
steps: Stand sideways to a high band anchor, grip the band palm up, and step away until your straight arm holds tension.
Brace your core and keep your upper arm elevated roughly parallel to the floor.
Curl your hand smoothly toward your temple by flexing strictly at the elbow while holding your upper arm still.
Extend your arm slowly back toward the anchor, then turn around and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your upper arm and shoulder stationary as the band draws your hand outward.
Avoid leaning your torso sideways to pull against peak tension.
